---
title: "Dr. Amina Msengwa"
---

**Senior Lecturer, Department of Statistics, University of Dar es Salaam**

With more than two decades of teaching and research experience, Dr.
Msengwa's expertise spans epidemiology, biostatistics, Bayesian
statistics, and spatial statistics. She has made significant
contributions to understanding and mapping disease burden in Tanzania,
and is dedicated to applying statistical models across health and
environmental domains.
